commit.message:
Improve test per review feedback

- Remove PASSED printings
- Cache dumpAtLevel() results to avoid re-running JVMs
- Each level checks for level-specific phases AND asserts absence of
  phases from the next level (e.g., level 1 must NOT contain PhaseCCP 1)
- Level 1: add Before Matching check
- Level 4: add Initial Liveness check
- Level 6: check for per-bytecode graphs (Bytecode 0: ...)
- Remove redundant testLevelSpecificPhases() method
- Multi-method test: verify each method emits its own Final Code graph
  within its group
- IGVPrintLevel directive: use CompileCommand=IGVPrintLevel syntax,
  remove compileonly to test directive-only behavior
